components.definition: Correctly separates potentially eligible, unlikely, insufficient-information and manual-review cases.
Uses only the policy for the resolved Singapore product and never mixes thresholds or limits.
Identifies the missing ticket, carrier confirmation, PIR, receipts or certificate.
Recommends practical next actions appropriate to the incident and evidence state.
Cites a matching authoritative source and policy chunk when making a benefit statement.
Does not promise payment; exposes uncertainty and routes conflicts or stale versions to human review.

hard_caps.condition: A response mixes a threshold or limit from another Card product.
A response promises claim approval or a payout.
An unknown, conflicting or uncovered product is not routed to human review.

case_score_formula: sum(component_score_0_to_1 * component_weight), then apply the lowest relevant hard cap
